title: Align Studio
shortDescription: From fingertip experiments to full-body interaction: a focused studio for 32 stretches and yoga movements.
longDescription: Align Studio develops the camera-based interaction explored in AI Hands and Finger Wand into a full-body movement-practice interface. The browser prototype offers 32 stretching and yoga references, a rotatable 3D guide, optional MediaPipe tracking, approximate joint-angle feedback, front and side reference views, and a manual hold timer. Camera frames are processed locally. FitAI is shown separately as the more complex movement studio. Reference similarity is not a guarantee of safe form.

title: Zhong Art
shortDescription: A website for exploring Chinese painting, bringing the 2D Cloud Court experiment into its carousel.
longDescription: Zhong Art brings Chinese painting into an interactive website, with an atlas, daily draw, and composition experiences. The Cloud Court and The Keeper of the Cloud Gate are related experiments inspired by Shuilu paintings: one explores a 2D animated scene, the other a 3D guardian sculpture. The 2D version was ultimately brought into Zhong Art as a carousel, connecting the earlier artwork exploration to the final website.

title: Behind the Event
shortDescription: Work in progress: a process journal following planning, coordination, and changes behind an event.
longDescription: An evolving case study about the work behind event planning: organizing people and information, preparing the venue, communicating, and responding to changes. The process journal is the starting point; the finished case study will grow from the work carried out during the event-planning process.
